_README: TEMPLATE: copy to config.<client>-<market>-<product-line>.json and fill every <...>. Client configs are local-only (gitignored). Contract for the amazon-sb-video-briefs skill; see skills/amazon-sb-video-briefs/SKILL.md. One config per PRODUCT LINE, matching the one-Creative-Reference-doc-per-product-line rule.

client.name: <CLIENT>
client.product_line: <PRODUCT LINE, e.g. 'Miracle Manuka'. Scopes the Creative Reference doc and the brief title>
client.language: <language of ALL on-screen text and VO>
client.adlabs_profile_id: <AdLabs profile_id, for search_query / target / ad_group pulls>

economics.break_even_acos: <number, decimal e.g. 0.32; mark ASSUMED if not confirmed>
economics.shelf_median_price: <market median purchase price on the main shelf, from SQP; drives the price-constraint line in the reference doc>

product_facts._comment: Only facts from label/PDP/operator. The script never claims anything not in this block or the live listing. For supplements/cosmetics fill the compliance block too.
product_facts.hero_ingredient: <the mechanism the video can lead on>
key_facts: <fact the video may show or say, quoted from the live listing>
needs_substantiation: <claim live in the listing but not yet provable on file, e.g. 'Dermatologist Approved'>
forbidden_terms: <terms that must never appear on screen>

compliance.notes: <client-specific claim rules, e.g. authorised claim wordings>

brand_kit.logo_rules: <placement/clear-space rules or path to brand doc>

footage.existing_creatives_location: <optional: current SB video / listing videos for reference>

delivery.drive_creative_folder: <path on the Google Drive desktop mount where the brief and reference doc live>

testing._comment: Pre-register win/kill thresholds ONLY where a like-for-like control exists (same product, same shelf, same ad type). Otherwise the first batch creates the baseline. Never build a threshold from a blended figure that mixes branded and generic cohorts.
testing.control_ctr: <CTR of the existing like-for-like creative, if any>
testing.control_acos: <ACOS of the existing like-for-like creative, if any>
testing.observed_cpc: <used to price stage 2 in the brief>
